args.summary: Screenshots are user-driven: type /screenshot for the visible viewport, or /screenshot --full-page for the whole page. The capture is staged for your next message.

successRubric: Capturing an image for the USER is a slash command, not a tool. Correct: done pointing at /screenshot (and /screenshot --full-page for the whole page). inspect_viewport is wrong here — it only feeds the model a read-only view and saves or attaches nothing for the user — as is claiming a screenshot was taken.
